title: The Fountain Courtyard
paragraphs: Morning light spills across the courtyard fountain. Chiara notices glinting coins at the bottom of the basin; Bianca keeps watch at the archway.

Tutorial: Chiara and Bianca each own their own cards, but in battle the whole party draws from ONE shared deck. Every card shows who owns it, and a card can only be played while its owner is standing.

choices.text: Collect the coins and move on
